title: What's New: Reservation Worksheet and Fulfillment Suggestions (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Classical Sales Order Workflow and Limitations
Reserved from Stock Indicator and Automatic Reservation

features.name: Reserved from Stock Indicator
features.description: A new field added to sales order lines and other demand documents showing the reservation status from stock with three options: none, partial, or fully reserved.

features.name: Reservation Worksheet
features.description: A new page that allows users to efficiently manage reservations by gathering demand documents, applying allocation policies, and creating reservations with dramatically fewer clicks than manual processes.

features.name: Allocate Action
features.description: An automated function in the Reservation Worksheet that recommends quantities to reserve by analyzing available stock and demand, making safe allocation decisions.
caveats: allocations may be skipped if quantity is insufficient

features.name: Allocation Policies
features.description: Multiple allocation strategies available in the Reservation Worksheet including a default safe allocation and an equally distributed option, with ability to combine policies and add custom rules.
caveats: currently only two policies available with plans to add more

features.name: Reservation Worksheet Batch Settings
features.description: Advanced settings for Reservation Worksheet allowing filtering by demand type, date range, items, location, and allocation policies to focus on specific company processes.
caveats: batch configuration requires understanding of filters and allocation rules

features.name: Automated Create Warehouse Shipments Report
features.description: A report that creates warehouse shipments filtered by reservation status, allowing only fully reserved items to be included in the shipment creation.

features.name: Automated Inventory Picks Creation
features.description: A function that creates inventory picks based on reservation status filters, allowing the system to automatically prepare picks for reserved items across different document types.

features.name: Statistics Page Reserved from Stock
features.description: Reservation status information integrated into statistics pages of various demand documents including sales orders, production orders, jobs, and consumption journals.

features.name: Show Details Feature
features.description: A feature that displays reservation details directly in production orders and other documents, allowing quick visibility of reserved quantities without navigating to separate pages.

features.name: Background Job Queue Processing
features.description: Ability to configure the system to run fulfillment tasks in the background via job queue, automatically creating warehouse shipments, inventory picks, or updating quantities to ship or consume.

features.name: Consumption Journal Filtering by Reservation
features.description: Consumption journal now supports filtering by reservation status to focus on specific components that meet reservation criteria.
